scope: Executable design specification; target runtime evidence is NOT STARTED

requirements.requirement: Target boundaries reject framework/domain and sibling-internal imports; fresh install/start is reproducible
Canonical ERP schema and migration parity in both modes
Pools and transaction context are bounded under route churn
Database denies cross-tenant read and write with missing/untrusted context
Owners/BYPASSRLS/superusers/functions/views cannot silently invalidate the runtime isolation proof
Concurrent API/worker/raw SQL connections retain transaction-local scope
Raw/bulk/join/export/error paths cannot leak ownership or inference
Trusted generation/lifecycle admission and local gates reject stale work
Pooled-to-dedicated transfer preserves full graph and bytes with safe rollback
OIDC cannot be forged or substituted for membership
Tenant membership is distinct from company permission
Revocation, suspension and dependency outage deny new operations
Organization and Inventory ownership/sharing keys cannot collapse scopes
Durable tenant-aware outbox/inbox/jobs tolerate duplicates and failures
Files/cache/search/report/export/notifications/audit/support tools enforce ownership
Dedicated and isolated pooled tenant restores meet approved recovery objectives
Entitlements/localization/secrets/audit/telemetry/deployment are operationally controlled
Foundation certification measures connection/latency/fairness/recovery against approved targets
Shared ERP masters preserve applicability, precision and authorization
Journals are balanced, immutable and correctly reversed
Stock movements/reservations/valuation reconcile under races
Complete order-to-cash/procure-to-pay/payments flows are ACID and recoverable
Reporting and release acceptance work across modes and company permissions

scenarios.setup: Fresh clean target checkout and disposable configuration
actions: Build every app and run AST dependency negative probes for aliases/reexports/dynamic imports and cycles
assertions: Valid exports build; all forbidden probes fail; readiness exposes no secrets

scenarios.setup: Empty pooled and dedicated disposable databases
actions: Apply canonical migrations twice, upgrade prior supported release and compare catalog/checksums
assertions: Equivalent schema/constraints/RLS/grants and version; rerun unchanged; drift quarantined

scenarios.setup: A/B pooled, C dedicated; selected driver with approved or synthetic test connection budget
actions: Run concurrent transaction/raw/model/outbox operations, timeout/rollback/retry, route churn and credential rotation; measure backend PID and total connections
assertions: Same PID/context per transaction; no leaks, bounded connections/queues; safe overload; leased pool not evicted
scenarios.fault: Exhaust pools and kill a connection mid-transaction

scenarios.setup: A/B in pooled tables; C dedicated; restricted runtime role and seeded marker rows
actions: Read/count/join, insert/update/delete under A/B/C and absent/malformed context; attempt tenant rewrite and dedicated wrong-tenant context
assertions: Only owned rows visible; wrong writes rejected/zero affected; WITH CHECK enforced; dedicated rejects A/B

scenarios.setup: Actual target role hierarchy/catalog
actions: Inspect rol attributes/table owners/FORCE RLS/policies/default grants; test runtime SET ROLE/TRUNCATE/DDL/definer/view access
assertions: Runtime cannot elevate or mutate policies; invoker views isolate; reviewed definer cannot cross tenant; test refuses privileged runtime
scenarios.fault: Introduce an unsafe view/role grant in disposable copy

scenarios.setup: Two pooled tenants and dedicated C with reused bounded pools
actions: Alternate requests and workers across tenants; commit/rollback/timeout/retry; run queries outside admitted transaction
assertions: Scope never carries over; no root query authorizes tenant data; missing context fails closed
scenarios.fault: Cancel requests after acquisition and before scope initialization

scenarios.setup: Seed equal business codes in A/B and two companies
actions: Attempt cross-scope FK, uniqueness conflicts, bulk updates, joins/counts/export and injection payloads
assertions: Same-tenant/company keys hold; safe errors hide unauthorized existence; no parameter interpolation

scenarios.setup: Live control plane and local per-tenant gates
actions: Spoof route hint/DB URL; suspend/freeze tenant while admitted requests and worker leases are active; outage registry
assertions: Client cannot select DB; stale generations cannot commit; freeze drains old writers; new admission fails closed
scenarios.fault: Crash between registry intent and local fence

scenarios.setup: A/B pooled plus C dedicated, destination matching lineage and object manifests
actions: Freeze A, transfer/checksum/cutover; replay every step; inject crashes at each checkpoint; test rollback before and after destination writes
assertions: A IDs/company links/rows/bytes/jobs/receipts preserved; B unchanged; no stale writes; postwrite rollback reverse-transfers; source retained
scenarios.fault: Crash after CAS before activation; fail object copy
scenarios.cleanup: Retain source; dispose only marked test cluster after evidence

scenarios.setup: Real test OIDC issuer and browser/BFF sessions
actions: Use wrong signature/issuer/audience, expired token, replayed code/state, denied MFA and membership-free subject
assertions: All invalid admission denied; valid principal limited to granted tenant; platform admin gains no content access

scenarios.setup: A1/A2 and C1/C2 with distinct users/roles
actions: Read/write/report company 2 as company 1 user; forge ownership; switch browser company with pending mutations
assertions: No unauthorized reads/writes/counts/draft results; authorized dual-company actions work

scenarios.setup: Real authoritative memberships and bounded sessions
actions: Revoke membership/session, reorder old grant events, suspend tenant and stop control plane; probe cached routes
assertions: New operations denied; old events cannot restore grants; documented bounded in-flight behavior; no cache fallback admission
scenarios.fault: Race grant updates and in-flight requests

scenarios.setup: Two companies per tenant with shared party/product applicability fixtures when available
actions: Create cross-tenant branches/cost centers and cross-company invalid associations; deactivate company with dependencies
assertions: Invalid graph rejected; grants reconcile fail closed; shared masters do not share balances/stock/prices

scenarios.setup: Actual broker/worker and ERP outbox/inbox fixtures
actions: Duplicate/reorder events; crash before/after commit/ack; retry/DLQ/replay and stale leases
assertions: One business effect, no silent job loss/cross-scope payload; bounded retries; DLQ visible

scenarios.setup: Real private object provider plus cache/index and authorized user fixtures
actions: Attempt foreign keys/prefixes/grants/recipients/export URLs/support views; switch tenant with delayed result; revoke link scope
assertions: No unauthorized bytes/results/recipients; byte integrity retained; residual signed TTL documented and measured

scenarios.setup: Marked disposable full backup + objects + provider side-effect receipts
actions: Restore C; restore whole pooled backup to isolated staging then extract A only; compare graph/bytes; reconcile external effects
assertions: B unchanged; source retained; accepted RPO/RTO measured; outbox/payment effects not blindly repeated

scenarios.setup: Actual containers and selected staging providers
actions: Disable capability, rotate secrets, inject telemetry failure, exercise MFA recovery audit, verify locale/RTL/timezone and runbooks
assertions: Use cases deny disabled capability with recovery permitted; no secrets/PII in logs; readiness detects incompatible schema

scenarios.setup: Approved owner values and representative A/B/C workloads
actions: Run concurrency/load/fault/browser/worker/transfer/DR rehearsals at approved envelope
assertions: Both modes and company scopes pass; measured percentiles, connections, loss/downtime within approved budgets
scenarios.fault: Noisy A tenant and provider failure under load

scenarios.setup: Real partner/product/variant/unit/tax/price/numbering UI and API in both modes
actions: Create and edit shared identity and company profiles; test scope, conversions, precision, tax and numbering collisions
assertions: Exact approved precision, no invalid scope/state or duplicate number, matching UI/API persistence

scenarios.setup: Actual company ledgers/accounts/periods/currency rules
actions: Post imbalance/cross-company entry, modify posted rows, reverse, close period concurrently and duplicate source
assertions: Invalid posts rejected; valid ledger balances; reversal links preserved; exactly one source posting

scenarios.setup: Actual warehouses/locations/products and approved valuation/negative policy
actions: Race reservations/issues/transfers/counts; test backdating/returns/unit rounding and cross-company locations
assertions: Conservation/ownership hold; immutable movements and approved valuation/journal reconcile; no duplicate issue

scenarios.setup: Actual approved sales/purchase/payment contracts and test bank adapter/provider
actions: Execute receipt/fulfillment/invoice/return/credit/refund/payment; inject failure after each module write and uncertain provider commit
assertions: All local effects rollback or commit together; duplicate retry one result; bank UNKNOWN reconciles before repeat; ledger/stock consistent
scenarios.fault: Network loss at provider confirmation and DB commit

scenarios.setup: Release images, approved staging integrations and complete ERP fixtures
actions: Run authorized reports/exports, deployment rollback, lifecycle/security/load/DR and full browser workflows
assertions: No cross-company totals or tenant leaks; release meets signed scope/SLO and provider acceptance; rollback rehearsed
